gate.name: Live-to-paper demotion gate
gate.rule: Any strategy holding LIVE status is demoted back to PAPER status immediately when ANY of the following is true: (a) over any rolling window of 100 settled bets the upper bound of the 95% CI of ROI is below 0; (b) its G2 signal metric underperforms its declared baseline in 2 consecutive weekly evaluations; (c) a high-severity data-integrity flag is opened against an input it depends on; or (d) its G7 market-verification requirement becomes satisfiable and the strategy then fails fair-vs-market comparison. Demotion requires no human approval; re-promotion to LIVE requires passing G1-G6 and G8 afresh on data not used to design the strategy.
gate.current_applications: No strategy currently holds LIVE status (all PAPER or BLOCKED), so D1 has not fired. D1 is wired so that any future promotion is automatically reversible.

result: no strategy holds LIVE status; D1 is armed and would fire on any of its four conditions
